content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary (INDEMN — deviation):** RevMed's Section 14.1 indemnity reaches only its negligence/recklessness/wilful misconduct and material breach of warranties or obligations. There is no third-party IP infringement indemnity anywhere in the agreement (Article X deals only with enforcement of patents against infringers, and Section 13.5 expressly disclaims any non-infringement warranty), no cover for RevMed's breach of Applicable Law, and no cover for RevMed-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of our data. Section 14.2, by contrast, gives RevMed a very broad indemnity from us.

Redline (preferred level, validated ok:true):
1. New 14.1(d)–(f): third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims, RevMed's breach of Applicable Law, and RevMed-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of Sanofi Confidential Information/data.
2. Conformed the "(a) through (c)" carve-out reference to "(a) through (f)".
3. Narrowed 14.2 to Sanofi-provided content and Sanofi's breach of Applicable Law.

Existing defend/affiliate coverage (14.1), notice (14.3(a)), control of defence (14.3(b)) and cooperation (14.3(e)) were already met and left verbatim; we did not import the fallback's procure/modify/replace/refund remedies or 3× super-cap, which would cap RevMed's currently uncapped indemnity.
